content.short: MoonBlast is a multi-chain EVM memecoin launchpad for one-click token creation.
content.description: MoonBlast is a no-code memecoin launchpad spanning Monad, Base and BNB Chain. A creator configures taxes at launch, choosing among a developer share, holder rewards and a burn, and deploys in one click. Launchpads that compete across several chains at once are betting that creators follow attention wherever it moves.
content.meta: One-click token creation across Monad, Base, BNB Chain and other EVM networks.
